### 1. Technology Stack & Design Rationale

| Layer | Technology | Rationale |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Framework** | **React 18** | High-performance component-driven architecture for rapid browsing, instant category switching, and interactive modals. |
| **Styling** | **Tailwind CSS** | Custom-configured luxury black-and-gold design system (`#090909` obsidian, `#171717` charcoal, `#C5A15A` warm gold, `#E2C58A` champagne gold, and `#F6F2E9` ivory). |
| **Typography** | **Cormorant Garamond + Plus Jakarta Sans** | Editorial luxury serif for headlines combined with a clean geometric sans-serif for optimal readability and modern prestige. |
| **Iconography** | **Lucide React** | Clean, minimalist, scalable vector icons with zero visual clutter. |
| **Routing** | **Dual Path & Hash Router** | Static-hosting compatible SPA routing supporting bookmarking, instant URL updates, and zero 404 page reloads. |
| **Build Tool** | **Vite** | Sub-second hot-reloading and lightweight production bundle. |

---

### 2. Completed Pages & Architecture

All 10 requested pages have been built and styled:

1. **Home (`/`)**:
   - Editorial hero section with the headline: **"VALUE WORTH DISCOVERING."**
   - High-impact visual retail showcase with primary CTA (*Explore Merchandise*) and secondary CTA (*Visit Our Store*).
   - Department highlights for Jewelry & Watches, Electronics, Tools, Instruments, and Collectibles.
   - Featured demonstration merchandise showcase with quick-view modal triggers.
   - **"Why Visit Peachtree Corners Loan & Pawn?"** value pillars (unique merchandise, changing inventory, dedicated team, accessible location).
   - Store visit section with verified address, direct phone link, and directions CTA.
2. **Shop (`/shop`)**:
   - Complete merchandise catalog browsing experience.
   - Live real-time search field (filtering by title, subcategory, and description).
   - Department filter pills (All, Jewelry & Watches, Electronics, Tools, Instruments, Collectibles).
   - Sort dropdown (*Featured*, *Price: Low to High*, *Price: High to Low*, *Name: A to Z*).
   - Interactive product cards with demonstration badges and "View Details" quick view.
3. **Jewelry (`/jewelry`)**:
   - Luxury landing page featuring watches, rings, necklaces, and bracelets.
   - Department filters for fine watches, diamond solitaires, gold chains, and tennis bracelets.
   - In-person gold and diamond evaluation information explaining certified testing standards.
4. **Electronics (`/electronics`)**:
   - Tech browsing for laptops, smartphones, noise-canceling headphones, and gaming consoles.
   - 3-step testing protocol highlight (data wipe, port/hardware inspection, hands-on in-store testing).
   - Availability notice advising visitors to call ahead.
5. **Tools & Equipment (`/tools`)**:
   - Commercial-grade cordless combo kits, miter saws, rotary lasers, and compressors.
   - Contractor equipment guidance and tools trade-in consultation.
6. **Musical Instruments (`/musical-instruments`)**:
   - Guitars (electric and acoustic), tube combo amplifiers, and weighted stage pianos.
   - Musician-friendly details on action setup and sound testing.
7. **Sell to Us (`/sell-to-us`)**:
   - Headline: **"TURN WHAT YOU OWN INTO AN OPPORTUNITY."**
   - Transparent 4-step selling process (gather items, bring valid photo ID, in-person evaluation, immediate payout).
   - Detailed breakdown of evaluated merchandise categories.
   - Interactive, validated frontend inquiry form with demonstration success state.
8. **Pawn Loans (`/pawn-loans`)**:
   - Headline: **"QUESTIONS ABOUT PAWN SERVICES?"**
   - Neutral, respectful, legally compliant collateral overview.
   - Clear "What to Bring" checklist (photo ID, physical item, accessories).
   - Clear disclosure that terms are handled in person per Georgia regulations.
9. **About (`/about`)**:
   - Introduces Peachtree Corners Loan & Pawn's retail vision and commitment to an elevated customer experience.
   - Verified location at 7040 Jimmy Carter Blvd in Peachtree Corners / Norcross.
10. **Contact (`/contact`)**:
    - Complete business information, click-to-call link, and Google Directions link.
    - Operating hours notice advising visitors to call ahead.
    - Validated contact inquiry form.
    - Embedded interactive map centering on 7040 Jimmy Carter Blvd.

---

### 3. Key Functional Features

- **Quick-View Product Details Modal**: Clicking "View Details" on any product opens an overlay with specifications, condition badges, estimated value, direct telephone link, and an online inquiry action.
- **Frontend Inquiry Validation**: The inquiry forms validate name, email, phone number, category, and description before presenting a demonstration confirmation receipt.
- **Responsive Mobile Navigation**: A sleek slide-out drawer menu featuring quick action buttons (*Call Store*, *Get Directions*) and categorized department links.
- **Centralized Business Configuration**: Business details (address, phone, map coordinates, legal disclaimers) are centralized in [`src/data/storeInfo.js`](file:///home/agent/workspace/src/data/storeInfo.js).
- **Centralized Catalog Data**: Demonstration items and categories are organized in [`src/data/inventory.js`](file:///home/agent/workspace/src/data/inventory.js).

---

### 4. Demonstration Data Notice

To protect the business and maintain technical isolation:
- **Demonstration Inventory**: Product photos, specifications, and values are realistic representations.
- **Demonstration Forms**: Form submissions validate inputs on the frontend and display a confirmation dialog; no customer data is transmitted to live databases.
- **Store Hours**: Opening hours are intentionally omitted with a polite notice inviting visitors to call `(678) 691-1692` for daily schedules.

---

### 5. Moving From Prototype to Production

When the store owners are ready to transition this into a live digital asset, the recommended roadmap includes:
1. **Live Inventory Integration**: Connect a lightweight Headless CMS or POS export (e.g., Bravo Pawn Systems or PawnMaster) to display verified in-store stock in real time.
2. **Form Backend & SMS Notifications**: Connect inquiries to the store’s official email or SMS notification line for rapid appraisal responses.
3. **Verified Operating Hours & Google Business Profile Sync**: Add official operating hours and embed Google Reviews via Google Business Profile API.
4. **Enhanced Local SEO**: Deploy JSON-LD structured data for `LocalBusiness` and `PawnShop` schemas.

### Executive Overview & Architecture

We have transformed the Peachtree Corners Loan & Pawn website into **The Vault** — a retail commerce, inventory intake, and customer relationship platform. The signature luxury black-and-gold visual identity, editorial typography, and existing showroom presentations have been preserved and expanded into a full-stack e-commerce system.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Client["Storefront Customer\n(Web & Mobile)"] --> Storefront["The Vault Storefront\n(Home, Showroom, Category Pages)"]
    Storefront --> Cart["Cart & Atomic Reservation Engine\n(15-min Lock)"]
    Cart --> Checkout["Hosted Tokenized Checkout\n(Square / Stripe Adapter)"]
    Checkout --> OrderPlaced["Order Processing & Inventory Deduction"]

    Staff["Store Floor Staff & Appraisers"] --> Admin["Admin Portal (/admin)\nRole-Based Access Control"]
    Admin --> SmartIntake["Smart Inventory Intake\nMode 1: Manual | Mode 2: Quick Add AI"]
    Admin --> InStoreSale["In-Store POS Sale Recorder\n(Unified Inventory Sync)"]
    Admin --> OrderFulfill["Order Fulfillment & Notes\n(Counter Pickup / Courier)"]
    Admin --> VaultWeekly["Marketing & The Vault Weekly\n(Unbundled Consent)"]

    OrderPlaced --> Notifications["Notification Center\n(Transactional HTML Emails & SMS)"]
    OrderPlaced --> AuditLog["Tamper-Evident Audit Trail"]
    SmartIntake --> DB[("Database Layer\n(PostgreSQL / Supabase Schema)")]
    InStoreSale --> DB
    OrderPlaced --> DB
```

### Core Platform Capabilities Implemented

#### 1. The Vault — Live Merchandise System
- **Central Homepage Attraction**: Prominent **"THE VAULT: JUST CAME IN. Discover what's new before somebody else does."** live showcase.
- **Dedicated The Vault Destination (`#/vault`)**: Live drop timers, Fast-Moving Stock alerts, filtering by category (Estate Jewelry & Luxury Watches, Contractor Equipment, Pro Sound & Guitars, Electronics), and sorting by newest arrivals or price.
- **Accurate Stock Status**: Items are tagged as `Available`, `Reserved` (in checkout session), or `Sold Out`. Sold items cannot be purchased again.
- **The Vault Weekly Sign-Up**: Prominent subscription module (`"THE BEST FINDS DON'T STAY SECRET"`).

#### 2. Smart Inventory Intake — Two-Mode Product Entry
Built specifically for fast store-floor intake on mobile devices and appraisal counters:
- **Mode 1: Manual Add**: Progressive disclosure form with multi-photo upload/preview/reordering, brand/model fields, karat/condition notes, price confirmation, and one-click *Save Draft*, *Publish Product*, or *Publish & Add Another*.
- **Mode 2: Quick Add AI (Photo-First)**:
  1. *Photo Intake*: Drag-and-drop or direct mobile camera snap.
  2. *Vision AI Analysis*: Analyzes markings, category, visible brand/model, cosmetic condition observations, customer-friendly editorial descriptions, and tags with per-field confidence badges (`Confirmed visually`, `AI suggestion — verify`).
  3. *Safety Guardrails*: Strictly enforces that visual inspection **never** certifies precious metal purity or mechanical functionality without physical testing.
  4. *Human Review & Pricing*: Store staff **must** verify and confirm the actual selling price and quantity before publishing.
  5. *Actions*: *Save Draft*, *Publish Product*, or *Publish & Add Another*.
- **In-Store POS Counter Sale Recorder**: Allows staff to record counter walk-in sales instantly, deducting stock from the website so merchandise is never double-sold online.

#### 3. Checkout, Cart & Payment Abstraction
- **Cart Slide-Over Drawer**: Real-time 15-minute atomic reservation timer preventing overselling of one-of-a-kind estate pieces.
- **Fulfillment Methods**:
  - *Free In-Store Counter Pickup*: Held at 7040 Jimmy Carter Blvd, Suite 4 with government ID verification requirement.
  - *Insured Courier Shipping*: Armored carrier delivery with signature confirmation.
- **Payment Gateway Abstraction ([`src/services/paymentAdapter.js`](file:///home/agent/workspace/src/services/paymentAdapter.js))**:
  - Tokenized checkout interface compatible with Square and Stripe.
  - Raw credit card and CVV numbers are never stored in application state or backend databases.
  - 1-click test cards provided for demonstration (Approved Card, 3D Secure Card, Declined Card).
  - Explicit merchant disclosure excluding pawn collateral loans from retail credit card checkout.

#### 4. Customer Account Portal (`#/account` & `#/auth`)
- **Strict Data Isolation**: Customers can only view their own order history, order numbers, and tracking information.
- **Profile & Marketing Preferences**: Unbundled, granular opt-ins for Email (Weekly Vault, New Arrivals) and SMS (Transactional updates vs. promotional alerts).
- **Security & Privacy**: Password changes and GDPR/CCPA-compliant account deletion workflow.

#### 5. Administrative Dashboard & Role-Based Access Control (`#/admin`)
- **Four Permission Tiers**:
  1. `OWNER / SUPER ADMIN`: Full administrative privileges, staff invites, and audit logs.
  2. `INVENTORY_MANAGER`: Product cataloging, Smart Inventory Intake, pricing, and in-store sales.
  3. `ORDER_MANAGER`: Order fulfillment, ready-for-pickup notifications, notes, and refunds.
  4. `MARKETING_MANAGER`: The Vault Weekly campaigns and subscriber lists.
- **Role Switcher**: Integrated in the admin header to immediately test permission restrictions.
- **Audit Trail**: Tamper-evident log recording timestamp, actor, IP address, action, and target entity.
- **Notification Center**: Live inspector for outgoing luxury black-and-gold transactional emails and carrier SMS dispatches.

### Setup & Operator Instructions

#### 1. First-Owner Setup & Bootstrap
1. The platform initializes with an Owner profile: `owner@pawnshopnorcross.com`.
2. Access the management portal at [`#/admin`](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/9f7c8288-36d4-48c5-9376-a200e0c955d0/61828e2cf85fa5093de0d99b/#/admin).
3. Use the **Active Staff Role** dropdown in the top header to navigate between `OWNER`, `INVENTORY_MANAGER`, `ORDER_MANAGER`, and `MARKETING_MANAGER` to test permission boundaries.
4. Under the **Staff & Roles** tab, the store owner can issue administrative invitations to staff members with restricted roles.

#### 2. Using Smart Inventory Intake
1. In the Admin Portal or Header, tap **Smart Intake**.
2. **Mode 2 (Quick Add AI)**:
   - Tap the camera upload zone or choose one of the one-click demo samples (*Swiss Watch*, *14K Gold Chain*, *Cordless Tool*).
   - Tap **Analyze Photographs with Vision AI**.
   - Review the suggested title, category, and condition notes.
   - **Confirm the Store Selling Price** (required; AI cannot set final prices).
   - Tap **Publish Product** or **Publish & Add Another**. The item appears in The Vault immediately.
3. **Mode 1 (Manual Add)**: Use the manual tab for complete field-by-field control.

#### 3. Recording an In-Store POS Sale
When a walk-in customer purchases an item at the 7040 Jimmy Carter Blvd counter:
1. Navigate to **Admin → Inventory**.
2. Find the item and tap **In-Store Sale**.
3. Confirm the cash or card register amount and click **Deduct Stock & Complete Sale**.
4. The item is marked sold immediately, preventing duplicate online purchases.

### Key Operational Systems Walkthrough

#### 1. Managing Aging Markdowns & Running the Engine
1. Navigate to **Admin → Aging & Markdowns** (at [`#/admin`](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/9f7c8288-36d4-48c5-9376-a200e0c955d0/61828e2cf85fa5093de0d99b/#/admin)).
2. Review the live showroom valuation before and after markdowns, total customer savings, and item counts by age tier.
3. Tap **Run Markdown Engine Now** to re-evaluate every item. If an item crossed an age boundary, its live price updates, a markdown history record is appended, and an entry is logged in the audit trail.
4. **Manual Safeguards**:
   - Tap **Override Price** on any row to set a custom retail price with an audit reason.
   - Tap **Pause / Resume** to exclude an item from automated price drops.
   - Toggle **Require Owner Sign-Off** to inspect proposed markdowns before publishing.

#### 2. Quick Add AI Inventory Intake
1. Tap **Smart Intake** in the top navigation bar or Admin header.
2. Select **Quick Add (AI Camera)**. Choose from sample photographs (*Swiss Watch*, *14K Gold Chain*, *Cordless Tool*) or upload camera photos.
3. Tap **Analyze Photographs with Vision AI**. The system suggests category, subcategory, condition notes, and tags.
4. **Mandatory Step**: Store staff reviews and enters the confirmed selling price. Tap **Publish Product** to immediately list the item in The Vault.

#### 3. In-Store POS Counter Sale Recording
When a walk-in customer purchases an item at the 7040 Jimmy Carter Blvd register:
1. Go to **Admin → Inventory**.
2. Locate the item and click **In-Store Sale**.
3. Confirm the selling price, select payment type (*Cash* or *In-Store POS Terminal*), and submit.
4. The system logs a `PC-POS-xxxx` completed order and decrements online stock immediately, preventing duplicate online checkouts.

#### 4. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Testing
Use the **Active Staff Role** dropdown in the top Admin bar to toggle between:
- `OWNER / SUPER ADMIN`: Unrestricted access across all tabs, markdown policy, invitations, and financial reports.
- `INVENTORY_MANAGER`: Product creation, Quick Add AI, in-store sales, price overrides, and markdown execution.
- `ORDER_MANAGER`: Order fulfillment status, tracking numbers, internal staff notes, and refund processing.
- `MARKETING_MANAGER`: Campaign composition, Vault Weekly drop dispatches, and subscriber management.
